prophecies.otTextZh: 那时，保佑你本国之民的天使长（原文是大君）米迦勒必站起来，并且有大艰难，从有国以来直到此时，没有这样的。你本国的民中，凡名录在册上的，必得拯救。
prophecies.ntText: For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now — and never to be equaled again.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 因为那时必有大灾难，从世界的起头直到如今，没有这样的灾难，后来也必没有。
prophecies.explanation: Daniel prophesied unprecedented tribulation. Jesus confirmed it — great distress unequaled in history. Both passages point to the same climactic period before God's kingdom is fully established.
prophecies.explanationZh: 但以理书、马太与启示录都预言大灾难的时期。弥赛亚再来前后有大苦难临到。这预言呼召圣徒在患难中坚忍等候。

interpretations.note: Shem. R. 15 — time of trouble and deliverance applied to Messianic era

prophecies.title: Scattered Children Gathered
prophecies.otText: Say of your brothers, "My people," and of your sisters, "My loved one."
prophecies.otTextZh: 你们要与你们的母亲大大争辩；因为她不是我的妻子，我也不是她的丈夫。叫她除掉脸上的淫像和胸间的淫态，
prophecies.ntText: He prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation, and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 也不但替这一国死，并要将神四散的子民都聚集归一。
prophecies.explanation: Hosea foresaw the day when the scattered would be called God's people again. John reveals that Jesus died to gather all of God's scattered children — Jew and Gentile — into one family.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚预言被分散的以色列「必被招聚」。耶稣也宣告要使被驱散的神的儿女聚集为一。弥赛亚拯救延及被掳、离散与远方之民。

interpretations.note: Midr. on Ps 45:1 — Israel redemption when reunited under one head

prophecies.title: David My Servant
prophecies.otText: Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days.
prophecies.otTextZh: 后来以色列人必归回（或译：回心转意），寻求他们的神─耶和华和他们的王大卫。在末后的日子，必以敬畏的心归向耶和华，领受他的恩惠。
prophecies.ntText: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 他要为大，称为至高者的儿子；主神要把他祖大卫的位给他。
prophecies.explanation: Hosea prophesied that Israel would seek David their king in the last days. Gabriel announced that Jesus would receive David's throne. The king Hosea foresaw is Christ — the ultimate David.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以西结以西卷常以「我的仆人大卫」形容将来的君王。弥赛亚虽非政治上的大卫，却是大卫真正的后裔。耶稣正是先知所称呼的那一位大卫。

interpretations.note: Targum — David raised up; Jer. Talmud derives Messiah name from David

prophecies.title: Death Swallowed Up
prophecies.otText: I will deliver this people from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. Where, O death, are your plagues? Where, O grave, is your destruction?
prophecies.otTextZh: 我必救赎他们脱离阴间，救赎他们脱离死亡。死亡啊，你的灾害在哪里呢？阴间哪，你的毁灭在哪里呢？在我眼前绝无后悔之事。
prophecies.ntText: Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?
prophecies.ntTextZh: 死啊！你得胜的权势在哪里？死啊！你的毒钩在哪里？
prophecies.explanation: Hosea challenged death and the grave with God's redemptive power. Paul echoes these exact words in celebration of Christ's resurrection — death has lost its sting, the grave its victory, through Jesus.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚宣告「死亡被吞灭直到永远」。保罗引此论到复活。弥赛亚的复活吞灭死亡的权势。最终死亡本身也失去它的最后权柄。

interpretations.note: Messiah delivers those of Israel in Gehinnom — sets free from death

prophecies.title: Grain Falling into Earth
prophecies.otText: They will blossom like the vine; Israel's fame will be like the wine of Lebanon. His young shoots will grow.
prophecies.otTextZh: 曾住在他荫下的必归回，发旺如五谷，开花如葡萄树。他的香气如黎巴嫩的酒。
prophecies.ntText: Very truly I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single seed. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，一粒麦子不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒，若是死了，就结出许多子粒来。
prophecies.explanation: Hosea foresaw Israel flourishing like a vine with spreading shoots. Jesus used similar imagery — a grain must die to bear fruit. His death was the seed that produced the worldwide harvest Hosea envisioned.
prophecies.explanationZh: 耶稣说「一粒麦子不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒」。这是他自己受死与复活的比喻。也回应了有关他处境的预言。他的死使多结果实。

interpretations.note: Messianically applied in Targum — reviving like grain

prophecies.title: All Nations Gathered
prophecies.otText: I will gather all nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will put them on trial for what they did to my inheritance, my people Israel.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我要聚集万民，带他们下到约沙法谷，在那里施行审判；因为他们将我的百姓，就是我的产业以色列，分散在列国中，又分取我的地土，
prophecies.ntText: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 万民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他们分别出来，好像牧羊的分别绵羊山羊一般，
prophecies.explanation: Joel prophesied God gathering all nations for judgment. Jesus described this same scene — all nations gathered before Him for separation. The Judge of Joel's vision is Christ on His throne.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚预言「列国要来就你的光」。这应许在末世外邦一同来朝拜神时显著。弥赛亚的国度是普世性的，万民都归于他。

interpretations.note: Midrashim apply valley of Jehoshaphat to Messianic judgment of nations

prophecies.title: Four Craftsmen
prophecies.otText: Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen. I asked, "What are these coming to do?" He answered, "These are the horns that scattered Judah... but the craftsmen have come to terrify them."
prophecies.otTextZh: 耶和华又指四个匠人给我看。
prophecies.ntText: Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 我听见以色列人各支派中受印的数目有十四万四千。
prophecies.explanation: Zechariah saw four craftsmen raised up to counter the powers that scattered God's people. Revelation shows 144,000 sealed from all tribes — God's complete answer to the scattering, gathering and protecting His own.
prophecies.explanationZh: 撒迦利亚异象中的「四个匠人」应验了弥赛亚的统治者带来坚固建造。耶稣引用匠人比喻建造成国度。神的建造超出人手的毁坏。

interpretations.note: Four craftsmen applied to Messianic figures in Talmud (Sukk. 52b)

prophecies.title: God Dwells Among Us
prophecies.otText: Shout and be glad, Daughter Zion. For I am coming, and I will live among you, declares the LORD.
prophecies.otTextZh: 锡安城啊，应当欢乐歌唱，因为我来要住在你中间。这是耶和华说的。
prophecies.ntText: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 道成了肉身，住在我们中间，充充满满地有恩典有真理。我们也见过他的荣光，正是父独生子的荣光。
prophecies.explanation: Zechariah proclaimed that God Himself would come and dwell among His people. John declares this fulfilled — the Word became flesh and tabernacled among us. God's promise to live with us became real in Jesus.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以马内利的意思是「神与我们同在」。以赛亚预言童女生子要名为「以马内利」。马太福音引证耶稣正是这应许的应验。十字架的阴影中，神仍与我们同在。

interpretations.note: Messianic passage — God dwelling among His people in Rabbinic sources

prophecies.title: Greeks Seek Jesus
prophecies.otText: In those days ten people from all languages and nations will take firm hold of one Jew by the hem of his robe and say, "Let us go with you, because we have heard that God is with you."
prophecies.otTextZh: 万军之耶和华如此说：在那些日子，必有十个人从列国诸族（原文是方言）中出来，拉住一个犹大人的衣襟，说：『我们要与你们同去，因为我们听见神与你们同在了。』」
prophecies.ntText: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the festival. They came to Philip with a request. "Sir," they said, "we would like to see Jesus."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 那时，上来过节礼拜的人中，有几个希腊人。
prophecies.explanation: Zechariah foresaw Gentiles from every nation seeking God through a Jew. John records Greeks coming to see Jesus — the fulfillment begins. The nations grasp the hem of Christ's robe.
prophecies.explanationZh: 约翰记载希腊人（外邦人）求见耶稣。这看似历史细节，实则应验「神的殿要作祷告的殿」和列国来就弥赛亚的预言。外邦人开始按应许亲近基督。

interpretations.note: Ten Gentiles grasp Jewish garment — Messianic ingathering in Rabbinic sources

prophecies.title: Chief Cornerstone
prophecies.otText: From Judah will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler.
prophecies.otTextZh: 房角石、钉子、争战的弓，和一切掌权的都从他而出。
prophecies.ntText: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the chief cornerstone.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 并且被建造在使徒和先知的根基上，有基督耶稣自己为房角石，
prophecies.explanation: Zechariah prophesied a cornerstone coming from Judah — the foundation of everything. Paul identifies Christ as the chief cornerstone on which the whole building of God's people rises.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚与诗篇都提到「房角的头块石头」。彼得称基督为「房角石」。被弃绝者却成为教会的根基，将万国与列邦连于一体。

interpretations.note: Messianically applied in Targum — cornerstone

prophecies.title: They Shall Mourn
prophecies.otText: The land will mourn, each clan by itself, with their wives by themselves: the clan of the house of David and their wives.
prophecies.otTextZh: 境内一家一家地都必悲哀。大卫家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。拿单家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。
prophecies.ntText: Look, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even those who pierced him; and all peoples on earth will mourn because of him.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 看哪，他驾云降临！众目要看见他，连刺他的人也要看见他；地上的万族都要因他哀哭。这话是真实的。阿们！
prophecies.explanation: Zechariah foresaw mourning over the one who was pierced. Revelation declares that every eye will see Christ — including those who pierced Him — and all peoples will mourn. The crucified one returns as the reigning King.
prophecies.explanationZh: 撒迦利亚预言「他们必仰望他们所扎的」而痛悔。这应于耶稣被扎受死时人们哀哭。也指向末世以色列仰望基督而哀哭悔改。

interpretations.note: Mourning for the pierced one — each family mourns separately (Talmud Sukk. 52a)

prophecies.title: Lion of Judah
prophecies.otText: Judah, your brothers will praise you; your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; your father's sons will bow down to you. You are a lion's cub, Judah.
prophecies.otTextZh: 犹大啊，你弟兄们必赞美你；你手必掐住仇敌的颈项；你父亲的儿子们必向你下拜。
prophecies.ntText: Then one of the elders said to me, "Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 长老中有一位对我说：「不要哭！看哪，犹大支派中的狮子，大卫的根，他已得胜，能以展开那书卷，揭开那七印。」
prophecies.explanation: Jacob blessed Judah as a lion's cub whose brothers would bow before him. Revelation identifies Jesus as the Lion of the tribe of Judah — the one who has triumphed and alone is worthy to open God's sealed scroll.
prophecies.explanationZh: 启示录称基督为「犹大的狮子」。这是创世记祝福犹大的应许之应验。那得胜的大卫后裔终于来到，胜过一切敌挡者。

interpretations.note: Lion whelp applied to the Messiah in Yalkut 160; Targum Pseudo-Jon. applies to Messiah kingship

prophecies.title: Nations as Inheritance
prophecies.otText: Ask me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.
prophecies.otTextZh: 你求我，我就将列国赐你为基业，将地极赐你为田产。
prophecies.ntText: To the one who is victorious and does my will to the end, I will give authority over the nations.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 他必用铁杖辖管（辖管：原文是牧）他们，将他们如同窑户的瓦器打得粉碎，像我从我父领受的权柄一样。
prophecies.explanation: The Father promised His Son the nations as inheritance. Revelation confirms that Christ shares this authority with those who overcome. The ends of the earth belong to Him, and He gives His followers a share in His reign.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇二篇宣告赐弥赛亚「列国为产业、地极为田产」。耶稣受死后得着超乎万有的权柄。国度延伸至全地，尤以万民为他的产业。

interpretations.note: Applied to Messiah receiving nations as inheritance in Ber. R. 44

prophecies.title: The King Victory
prophecies.otText: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD. How great is his joy in the victories you give!
prophecies.otTextZh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华啊，王必因你的能力欢喜；因你的救恩，他的快乐何其大！
prophecies.ntText: Then Jesus came to them and said, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 耶稣进前来，对他们说：「天上地下所有的权柄都赐给我了。
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist celebrated a king rejoicing in God-given victories. Jesus declared that all authority — in heaven and on earth — has been given to Him. The ultimate royal victory is Christ's.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇预告王以得胜进入城门。耶稣荣入圣城、胜过死亡、升入荣耀，正是这预言得胜之王的应验。他的得胜超乎军事而关乎救赎。

interpretations.note: Psalm 21 applied to the Messiah throughout by the Targum

prophecies.title: Son of Man at God Right Hand
prophecies.otText: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.
prophecies.otTextZh: 愿你的手扶持你右边的人，就是你为自己所坚固的人子。
prophecies.ntText: And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 耶稣说：「我是。你们必看见人子坐在那权能者的右边，驾著天上的云降临。」
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist prayed for God's hand to rest on the son of man at His right hand. Jesus declared that He is that Son of Man — seated at the right hand of the Mighty One, coming on heaven's clouds.
prophecies.explanationZh: 司提反在异象中看见「人子站在神的右边」。这正应验诗篇与但以理的预言。耶稣升天、坐在全能者右边正是这计划的应验。

interpretations.note: Son of Man paraphrased by the Targum as King Messiah

prophecies.title: God Anointed Exalted
prophecies.otText: No enemy will subject him to tribute; no wicked man will oppress him. I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.
prophecies.otTextZh: 仇敌必不勒索他；凶恶之子也不苦害他。
prophecies.ntText: Then Jesus came to them and said, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 耶稣进前来，对他们说：「天上地下所有的权柄都赐给我了。
prophecies.explanation: God promised in Psalm 89 that no enemy would prevail against His anointed. Jesus received all authority in heaven and earth — every foe is crushed, every adversary struck down by God's exalted King.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇预言受膏者被高举在君王与统治者之上。耶稣的复活与升天是「被神高举」的应验。他的名超乎万名之上。

interpretations.note: Promise of God anointed applied to the Messiah in Yalkut on Isaiah 60

prophecies.title: Desert Blooming
prophecies.otText: The desert and the parched land will be glad; the wilderness will rejoice and blossom. Like the crocus, it will burst into bloom.
prophecies.otTextZh: 旷野和干旱之地必然欢喜；沙漠也必快乐；又像玫瑰开花，
prophecies.ntText: Go back and report to John what you hear and see: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, those who have leprosy are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 就是瞎子看见，瘸子行走，长大痲疯的洁净，聋子听见，死人复活，穷人有福音传给他们。
prophecies.explanation: Isaiah prophesied the desert blooming and the weak being strengthened. Paul declared that all creation groans in anticipation of the new world God is bringing. Isaiah's desert has burst into bloom — and one day the whole creation will share in the freedom and glory of God's children.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚预言「旷野和干旱之地必然欢喜」。耶稣的救赎与圣灵的工作让贫瘠之地开花。弥赛亚使不具生机的枯地重获新生。

interpretations.note: Desert blossoming and healing applied to Messianic era in Yalkut and Talmud

prophecies.title: The Servant Exalted
prophecies.otText: See, my servant will act wisely; he will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我的仆人行事必有智慧（或译：行事通达），必被高举上升，且成为至高。
prophecies.ntText: Therefore God exalted him to the highest place and gave him the name that is above every name.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 所以，神将他升为至高，又赐给他那超乎万名之上的名，
prophecies.explanation: Isaiah foretold a servant who would be highly exalted. Paul declares that God has done exactly this — exalting Christ to the highest place with the name above every name. The suffering servant is the exalted Lord.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚预言「我的仆人行事必有智慧，必被高举上升」。耶稣降卑自己，神将他升为至高。十字架之后是至高的尊荣。

interpretations.note: Servant exalted and lifted up applied to the Messiah in Yalkut; introduces Suffering Servant

prophecies.title: David Raised Up
prophecies.otText: They will serve the LORD their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
prophecies.otTextZh: 你们却要事奉耶和华─你们的神和我为你们所要兴起的王大卫。」
prophecies.ntText: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 他要为大，称为至高者的儿子；主神要把他祖大卫的位给他。
prophecies.explanation: Jeremiah prophesied that God would raise up David their king. Gabriel announced Jesus as the Son of the Most High who receives David's throne. Christ is the David whom God raises up for His people.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚与以西结都提到神把大卫兴起为弥赛亚的预表。耶稣因此被称为大卫的后裔。大卫所欠的福分由这位更大的后裔应验。

interpretations.note: Serving the LORD and David raised up applied to Messianic era in Talmud

prophecies.title: The Tender Branch
prophecies.otText: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself will take a shoot from the very top of a cedar and plant it; I will break off a tender sprig from its topmost shoots and plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
prophecies.otTextZh: 主耶和华如此说：「我要将香柏树梢拧去栽上，就是从尽尖的嫩枝中折一嫩枝，栽于极高的山上；
prophecies.ntText: He told them another parable: "The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his field. Though it is the smallest of all seeds, yet when it grows, it is the largest of garden plants."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 这原是百种里最小的，等到长起来，却比各样的菜都大，且成了树，天上的飞鸟来宿在它的枝上。」
prophecies.explanation: Ezekiel described God planting a tender branch that grows into a great tree. Jesus used the same image — the kingdom starts small like a mustard seed and grows to shelter all. God's kingdom begins humbly but becomes immense.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚以西结都以「嫩苗/枝子」称呼弥赛亚。那从被砍下之耶西树根长出的嫩苗代表残破中仍有生命。耶稣正是从当大卫家失败中长出的盼望。

interpretations.note: Tender branch planted on a high mountain applied to the Messiah in the Targum on Ezekiel

prophecies.title: Cleansing and New Spirit
prophecies.otText: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; I will cleanse you from all your impurities and from all your idols. I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我必用清水洒在你们身上，你们就洁净了。我要洁净你们，使你们脱离一切的污秽，弃掉一切的偶像。
prophecies.ntText: Jesus answered, "Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你，人若不是从水和圣灵生的，就不能进神的国。
prophecies.explanation: Ezekiel prophesied cleansing with water and a new spirit. Jesus told Nicodemus that entering God's kingdom requires being born of water and the Spirit — Ezekiel's prophecy describes the new birth Christ makes possible.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以西结预言「我必洁净你们，赐给你们新心新灵」。耶稣差遣圣灵革新人。圣灵使我们成为新造的人正如先知所应许。

interpretations.note: Cleansing with water and new spirit applied to spiritual renewal of Messianic era

prophecies.title: Stone Cut Without Hands
prophecies.otText: While you were watching, a rock was cut out, but not by human hands. It struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay and smashed them.
prophecies.otTextZh: 你观看，见有一块非人手凿出来的石头打在这像半铁半泥的脚上，把脚砸碎；
prophecies.ntText: Anyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 谁掉在这石头上，必要跌碎；这石头掉在谁的身上，就要把谁砸得稀烂。」
prophecies.explanation: Daniel saw a stone cut without human hands that destroyed every earthly kingdom. Jesus applied this to Himself — He is the stone that breaks and crushes. God's kingdom replaces every human empire.
prophecies.explanationZh: 但以理梦见「非人手凿出来的石头」击碎列国且充满全地。耶稣建立的是属天的国度而非地上的帝国。弥赛亚的国度不靠人手的强度而是神的大能建立。

interpretations.note: Stone cut without hands destroying the statue applied to Messianic kingdom in Talmud

prophecies.title: The Breaker Goes Before
prophecies.otText: The One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate and go out. Their King will pass through before them, the LORD at their head.
prophecies.otTextZh: 开路的（或译：破城的）在他们前面上去；他们直闯过城门，从城门出去。他们的王在前面行；耶和华引导他们。
prophecies.ntText: The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep. The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 既放出自己的羊来，就在前头走，羊也跟著他，因为认得他的声音。
prophecies.explanation: Micah prophesied a Breaker who goes before His people, opening the way. Jesus declared Himself the shepherd who enters by the gate, leading His sheep out. He is the one who breaks through every barrier for His flock.
prophecies.explanationZh: 弥迦预言「开路的在他们前面上去」。弥赛亚身为开路者，为我们开了一条通向神的道路。耶稣就是那越过坟墓、进入至圣所的开路先锋。

interpretations.note: Breaker going before the flock applied to the Messiah in Ber. R. 48 and Bemid. R. 14

prophecies.title: Spirit Resting on the Branch
prophecies.otText: The Spirit of the LORD will rest on him — the Spirit of wisdom and of understanding, the Spirit of counsel and of might, the Spirit of the knowledge and fear of the LORD.
prophecies.otTextZh: 耶和华的灵必住在他身上，就是使他有智慧和聪明的灵，谋略和能力的灵，知识和敬畏耶和华的灵。
prophecies.ntText: And the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 圣灵降临在他身上，形状彷佛鸽子；又有声音从天上来，说：「你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。」
prophecies.explanation: Isaiah described the Spirit resting on the Branch in fullness — wisdom, understanding, counsel, might. At Jesus' baptism, the Spirit descended visibly, and the Father confirmed: this is My beloved Son. Isaiah's sevenfold Spirit rests on Christ.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚预言「耶和华的灵必住在他身上」,以及弥赛亚的智慧与谋略。耶稣受洗时圣灵降在他身上。这灵是弥赛亚一切服事的能力之源。

interpretations.note: Seven spirits of wisdom resting on Messiah extensively cited in Talmud

interpretations.title: Special Anointing of Holy Spirit
interpretations.note: Targum Isaiah on Isa 11:1-4 cited verbatim; seven-fold Spirit at baptism

prophecies.title: Seed of Abraham
prophecies.otText: and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed me.
prophecies.otTextZh: 并且地上万国都必因你的后裔得福，因为你听从了我的话。』」
prophecies.ntText: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. Scripture does not say "and to seeds," meaning many people, but "and to your seed," meaning one person, who is Christ.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 所应许的原是向亚伯拉罕和他子孙说的。神并不是说「众子孙」，指著许多人，乃是说「你那一个子孙」，指著一个人，就是基督。
prophecies.explanation: God promised Abraham that all nations would be blessed through his seed. Paul identifies this seed as Christ — the singular offspring through whom every nation receives blessing. The Abrahamic covenant finds its fulfillment in Jesus.
prophecies.explanationZh: 加拉太书说凡属基督的就是亚伯拉罕的后裔。这应验「万国必因你的后裔得福」的应许。耶稣就是那一个后裔，也让所有信者成为亚伯拉罕的子孙。

interpretations.note: Through Abraham's seed all nations blessed; Payne points to the singular 'seed' as anticipating Gal 3:16
Bemidbar R. 13 — universal blessing through Messiah

interpretations.title: Seed of Abraham
interpretations.note: Matthew Henry: 'in thy Seed one particular person' — Gal 3:16 singular seed argument

prophecies.title: Son of Isaac
prophecies.otText: Through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.
prophecies.otTextZh: 神对亚伯拉罕说：「你不必为这童子和你的使女忧愁。凡撒拉对你说的话，你都该听从；因为从以撒生的，才要称为你的后裔。
prophecies.ntText: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 犹大是雅各的儿子；雅各是以撒的儿子；以撒是亚伯拉罕的儿子；亚伯拉罕是他拉的儿子；他拉是拿鹤的儿子；
prophecies.explanation: God specified that the promised line would flow through Isaac, not Ishmael. Luke's genealogy confirms Jesus descends through Isaac — the child of promise. God's covenant faithfulness is traced through every generation.
prophecies.explanationZh: 上帝从以撒立约使万族得福。路加宣告基督按肉身乃自亚伯拉罕、以撒。以撒的独生子所预表的成全了独生子的舍己。

interpretations.title: Son of Isaac
interpretations.note: God eliminates half of Abraham lineage — Ishmael excluded

prophecies.title: Judge, Lawgiver, King
prophecies.titleZh: 审判官、律法颁布者、君王
prophecies.otText: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; it is he who will save us.
prophecies.otTextZh: 因为，耶和华是审判我们的；耶和华是给我们设律法的；耶和华是我们的王；他必拯救我们。
prophecies.ntText: By myself I can do nothing; I judge only as I hear, and my judgment is just, for I seek not to please myself but him who sent me.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 「我凭著自己不能做甚么，我怎么听见就怎么审判。我的审判也是公平的；因为我不求自己的意思，只求那差我来者的意思。」
prophecies.explanation: Isaiah declared God as judge, lawgiver, and king — the one who saves. Jesus exercises all three roles — judging justly, fulfilling the law, and reigning as king — yet always in submission to the Father.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚说耶和华是审判官、律法颁布者、君王。基督作为审判官、立法者与君王成全这一切职分。神亲自在弥赛亚中以三种权柄施行拯救。

interpretations.title: Judge
interpretations.note: LORD as Judge

prophecies.title: King on Holy Hill
prophecies.otText: I have installed my king on Zion, my holy mountain.
prophecies.otTextZh: 说：我已经立我的君在锡安─我的圣山上了。
prophecies.ntText: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 在他头以上安一个牌子，写著他的罪状，说：「这是犹太人的王耶稣。」
prophecies.explanation: God declared in Psalm 2 that He installed His king on Zion. At Calvary, the sign above Jesus read "King of the Jews" — what Pilate meant as mockery, God meant as coronation. The cross was His throne.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇宣告「我已经立我的君在锡安我的圣山」。耶稣作为万王之王在锡安作王。他的国度建立于圣山上，从锡安扩展到全地。

interpretations.title: King
interpretations.note: Set as King on Zion; Jer 23:5 and Zech 9:9 cited as parallels; cross placard 'King of the Jews'

prophecies.title: He Bore Our Suffering
prophecies.otText: Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering, yet we considered him punished by God, stricken by him, and afflicted.
prophecies.otTextZh: 他诚然担当我们的忧患，背负我们的痛苦；我们却以为他受责罚，被神击打苦待了。
prophecies.ntText: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).
prophecies.ntTextZh: 他们就把耶稣带了去。耶稣背著自己的十字架出来，到了一个地方，名叫「髑髅地」，希伯来话叫各各他。
prophecies.explanation: Isaiah declared that the Servant would bear our suffering — taking up our pain though we thought him punished by God. Jesus carried His own cross to Golgotha, bearing the weight of human sin and sorrow. What Isaiah foretold, Christ fulfilled in His body on the way to Calvary.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚五十三章刻画弥赛亚「担当我们的忧患、背负我们的痛苦」。马太福音确认耶稣的医治正是此应验。他要承担我们的破碎、弥补我们的伤痛。

interpretations.title: Fell under the Cross
interpretations.note: Knees weak from fasting

prophecies.title: Friends Stood Afar Off
prophecies.otText: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我的良朋密友因我的灾病都躲在旁边站著；我的亲戚本家也远远地站立。
prophecies.ntText: But all those who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 还有一切与耶稣熟识的人，和从加利利跟著他来的妇女们，都远远地站著看这些事。
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist lamented that friends and companions withdrew because of his suffering. At the cross, those who knew Jesus stood at a distance, watching. The isolation of suffering was part of the Messiah's cost.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇预言「朋友也远远站着」。十字架下的门徒几乎都远远观看、离开。这使得耶稣在最被弃绝时仍独自面对。预言精确到这个细节。

interpretations.title: Friends Stood Afar Off
interpretations.note: Loved ones and friends stand aloof from plague; Luke 23:49 — all acquaintances watched at a distance

prophecies.title: They Wagged Their Heads
prophecies.otText: Those who see me shake their heads.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我受他们的羞辱，他们看见我便摇头。
prophecies.ntText: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 从那里经过的人讥诮他，摇著头，说：
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist described onlookers shaking their heads in contempt. Matthew records the same scene at Calvary — passersby hurled insults and shook their heads at Jesus. The psalm was a script, and the cross was its stage.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇预言旁观者「摇头」向受难者讥诮。十字架下的人群确实摇头嗤笑。受难现场的讽刺在预言中早已预告。

interpretations.title: People Shook Their Heads
interpretations.note: Ethridge: gesture implying no hope for the sufferer; Matt 27:39 — passersby wagging heads at the cross

prophecies.title: They Look and Stare
prophecies.otText: I can count all my bones; people stare and gloat over me.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我的骨头，我都能数过；他们瞪著眼看我。
prophecies.ntText: The people stood watching, and the rulers even sneered at him. They said, "He saved others; let him save himself if he is God's Messiah, the Chosen One."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 百姓站在那里观看。官府也嗤笑他，说：「他救了别人；他若是基督，神所拣选的，可以救自己吧！」
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist described being stared at and gloated over. Luke records the crowd watching and sneering at Jesus on the cross. Every detail of Psalm 22 was lived out in Christ's crucifixion.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇说「他们瞪着眼看我」。十字架成为众人注目的中心。这显明预言式的细节，耶稣的受苦被公开展示。

interpretations.title: Stared Upon
interpretations.note: Can count all bones; they look and stare — crowd standing watching the crucifixion

prophecies.title: Not One Bone Broken
prophecies.otText: He protects all his bones, not one of them will be broken.
prophecies.otTextZh: 又保全他一身的骨头，连一根也不折断。
prophecies.ntText: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 只是来到耶稣那里，见他已经死了，就不打断他的腿。
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist declared that God protects His righteous one — not a bone will be broken. At the cross, the soldiers broke the legs of the two criminals but found Jesus already dead. God protected His Son's bones, fulfilling the psalm.
prophecies.explanationZh: 出埃及记吩咐逾越节的羔羊骨头不可折断。约翰在十字架下看到「骨节不折断」的应验。耶稣正是那位无瑕疵、不折断的羔羊。

interpretations.note: Not one bone broken; Payne connects this to the Passover lamb's bones (Exod 12:46) as a dual fulfillment

interpretations.title: Bones Not Broken
interpretations.note: God guards all His bones; soldiers skipped breaking Jesus' legs because He was already dead — John 19:33

prophecies.title: Heart Poured Out
prophecies.otText: All my bones are out of joint. My heart has turned to wax; it has melted within me.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我如水被倒出来；我的骨头都脱了节；我心在我里面如蜡镕化。
prophecies.ntText: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus' side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 惟有一个兵拿枪扎他的肋旁，随即有血和水流出来。
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist described a heart melted like wax within him. When the soldier pierced Jesus' side, blood and water flowed — medical evidence of a heart that literally burst. Psalm 22 described the Messiah's death a thousand years before the cross.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇放下「我的心如蜡熔化」，表达十分痛苦。十架上耶稣的极度痛苦以此为预表。这比喻的痛比身体钉伤更为深刻。

interpretations.title: Heartbroken
interpretations.note: Heart like wax melted within; blood and water from the pierced side are evidence the heart had literally burst

prophecies.title: Son of the Father
prophecies.otText: I will be his father, and he will be my son.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖责打他，用人的鞭责罚他。
prophecies.ntText: For to which of the angels did God ever say, 'You are my Son; today I have become your Father'?
prophecies.ntTextZh: 所有的天使，神从来对哪一个说：你是我的儿子，我今日生你？又指著哪一个说：我要作他的父，他要作我的子？
prophecies.explanation: God's covenant with David included a father-son relationship with his successor. The author of Hebrews applies this promise exclusively to Jesus — not to angels, not to any earthly king — as evidence of the Son's unique divine status.
prophecies.explanationZh: 弥赛亚被称颂为「父的儿子」。耶稣是神独生子，从父而来。这称呼与他所成之工相符，他由父差来作救主。

interpretations.note: Father-son covenant relationship; Payne sees this as the relational heart of the Davidic covenant

prophecies.title: Blessed Is He Who Comes
prophecies.titleZh: 奉主名来的是应当称颂的
prophecies.otText: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
prophecies.otTextZh: 奉耶和华名来的是应当称颂的！我们从耶和华的殿中为你们祝福！
prophecies.ntText: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest heaven!
prophecies.ntTextZh: 前行后随的众人喊著说：和散那（原有求救的意思，在此是称颂的话）归于大卫的子孙！奉主名来的是应当称颂的！高高在上和散那！
prophecies.explanation: Psalm 118 was sung at Passover as pilgrims processed to the temple. When the crowd greeted Jesus with these exact words on Palm Sunday, they were identifying him as the expected king coming in God's name — a fulfillment the religious leaders understood immediately.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇预言「奉耶和华名来的是应当称颂的」。群众在耶稣荣入圣城欢呼这节经文。如此应验了君王进城的预言。

interpretations.note: Blessed is He who comes in the LORD's name; Payne notes the Hallel psalm was the Passover processional

prophecies.title: Throne of His Body
prophecies.otText: The LORD swore an oath to David, a sure oath he will not revoke: 'One of your own descendants I will place on your throne.'
prophecies.otTextZh: 耶和华向大卫、凭诚实起了誓，必不反覆，说：我要使你所生的坐在你的宝座上。
prophecies.ntText: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 大卫既是先知，又晓得神曾向他起誓，要从他的后裔中立一位坐在他的宝座上，
prophecies.explanation: Psalm 132 affirms the unconditional nature of the Davidic covenant — God swore an oath that David's bodily descendant would occupy his throne. Peter at Pentecost declared that Jesus' resurrection fulfilled this oath, establishing the Davidic heir on an eternal throne beyond the reach of death.
prophecies.explanationZh: 先知书应许大卫的后裔要永远坐在他的宝座上。路加并称耶稣为那坐在大卫宝座上的后裔。大卫位分由弥赛亚继承并永远坚立。

interpretations.note: Bodily descendant of David placed on the throne; Payne connects the oath-formula here to the unbreakable permanence of the Davidic covenant

prophecies.title: Tongue Cleaves, "I Thirst"
prophecies.otText: My mouth is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me in the dust of death.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我的精力枯干，如同瓦片；我的舌头贴在我牙床上。你将我安置在死地的尘土中。
prophecies.ntText: Later, knowing that everything had now been finished, and so that Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, "I am thirsty."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 这事以后，耶稣知道各样的事已经成了，为要使经上的话应验，就说：「我渴了。」
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist described a mouth dried like pottery and a tongue stuck fast — the agony of dehydration in death. On the cross, Jesus said 'I am thirsty,' and John explicitly notes it was to fulfill Scripture. The Passion Psalm's details were lived out in Christ's final hours.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇描写弥赛亚「舌头贴住上膛」。耶稣在十架上喊「我渴了」正合此预言。口渴与审判的干渴连接着十字架上的舍身。

interpretations.note: Tongue cleaves to jaws; Payne treats Psalm 22 as the most detailed prophetic portrait of crucifixion
Psalm 22 treated as complete Messianic Passion Psalm; thirst and physical torment applied to Messiah's suffering in ancient Synagogue

interpretations.title: Gall and Vinegar Offered
interpretations.note: Tongue cleaves to jaws — thirst on the cross; John 19:28 explicitly states fulfillment of Scripture

prophecies.title: Who Has Believed
prophecies.otText: Who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?
prophecies.otTextZh: 我们所传的（或译：所传与我们的）有谁信呢？耶和华的膀臂向谁显露呢？
prophecies.ntText: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: "Lord, who has believed our message, and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"
prophecies.ntTextZh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说：主啊，我们所传的有谁信呢？主的膀臂向谁显露呢？
prophecies.explanation: Isaiah opened the Suffering Servant passage with a grieving question — who has believed? John cites this verse to explain why so many refused to believe in Jesus despite His signs. The rejection was not an accident; it was woven into the prophetic pattern from the start.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚问「我们所传的有谁信呢」。福音的到来面对不信与刚硬。十字架同时显明神的爱与人的弃绝。

interpretations.note: Who has believed our report; Payne treats this as the heading of the Servant's rejection
Isaiah 53:1 cited in Messianic context; disbelief of the report applied to rejection of the Messiah in Talmud and Yalkut

interpretations.title: Rejected by His Own People
interpretations.note: Who has believed our report — John 12:38 and Romans 10:16 both cite this as fulfilled in Israel's rejection of the Messiah

prophecies.title: Every Knee Shall Bow
prophecies.otText: By myself I have sworn, my mouth has uttered in all integrity a word that will not be revoked: Before me every knee will bow; by me every tongue will swear.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我指著自己起誓，我口所出的话是凭公义，并不反回：万膝必向我跪拜；万口必凭我起誓。
prophecies.ntText: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth, and every tongue acknowledge that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
prophecies.ntTextZh:
叫一切在天上的、地上的，和地底下的，因耶稣的名无不屈膝，
无不口称「耶稣基督为主」，使荣耀归与父神。
prophecies.explanation: Through Isaiah, God swore an irrevocable oath that every knee would bow to Him alone. Paul applies this oath directly to Jesus — at His name every knee in heaven, earth, and under the earth will bow. What God declared of Himself, the apostle declares of Christ.
prophecies.explanationZh: 先知宣告「万膝必向我跪拜」。腓立比书把万膝跪拜归于基督之名。弥赛亚是普世敬拜的对象，宇宙都在他面前屈膝。

interpretations.note: Every knee shall bow; Payne notes Paul's transfer of this monotheistic oath to Christ in Philippians 2 as evidence of the highest Christology
Every knee bowing applied to Messianic era; Isaiah 45:23 cited in Talmudic discussion of universal acknowledgment of God through Messiah

interpretations.title: Shall Be Called Lord
interpretations.note: Every knee bowing and tongue confessing; Phil 2:10–11 applies Yahweh's oath to Jesus as Lord

prophecies.title: Stranger to His Brothers
prophecies.otText: I am a foreigner to my own family, a stranger to my own mother's children.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我的弟兄看我为外路人；我的同胞看我为外邦人。
prophecies.ntText: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 因为连他的弟兄说这话，是因为不信他。
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist lamented being treated as a stranger by his own siblings. Jesus experienced the same — His own brothers did not believe in Him during His earthly ministry. The Messiah's rejection began not with enemies, but at home.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇以「弟兄」喻弥赛亚遭卖为外邦人的经历。使徒与初代教会都看耶稣是被亲族弃绝的弟兄。这一弃绝却向万邦敞开恩门。

interpretations.note: Psalm 69 treated as Messianic; alienation from brethren applied to Messiah's rejection by His own in Rabbinic commentary

prophecies.title: Raised on the Third Day
prophecies.otText: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will restore us, that we may live in his presence.
prophecies.otTextZh: 过两天他必使我们甦醒，第三天他必使我们兴起，我们就在他面前得以存活。
prophecies.ntText: He told them, "This is what is written: The Messiah will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,"
prophecies.ntTextZh: 又对他们说：「照经上所写的，基督必受害，第三日从死里复活，
prophecies.explanation: Hosea's prophecy of revival after two days and restoration on the third established a prophetic pattern that Jesus directly cited. When He explained the Scriptures after His resurrection, He pointed to this very pattern — that it was written the Messiah would rise on the third day. This is one of the most direct prophetic anticipations of the resurrection in the entire Old Testament.
prophecies.explanationZh: 何西阿预言「第三日他必使我们兴起」。耶稣多次预讲自己第三日复活。保罗说他是照圣经所记第三日复活的。三日复活成为福音的核心确据。

interpretations.note: Revival after two days and raising on the third day; Payne treats this as a prophetic pattern directly fulfilled in Christ's resurrection — listed as #78 in his 191 messianic prophecies
Hos. vi. 2 is Messianically applied in the Targum — explicitly confirmed in Appendix IX of The Life and Times of Jesus the Messiah

prophecies.title: No Comforters in His Suffering
prophecies.otText: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.
prophecies.otTextZh: 辱骂伤破了我的心，我又满了忧愁。我指望有人体恤，却没有一个；我指望有人安慰，却找不著一个。
prophecies.ntText: "My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death," he said to them. "Stay here and keep watch."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 对他们说：「我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死；你们在这里等候，警醒。」
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist cried out that scorn had broken his heart and no comforter could be found. In the Garden of Gethsemane, Jesus poured out His anguish to Peter, James, and John — yet they fell asleep while He suffered alone. The Messiah's deepest agony was met not with comfort but with the solitude foretold centuries earlier.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇说「我找安慰人的却找不着」。十字架下的人们虽有同在却无人能分担这深处的孤绝。这使耶稣完全独自承担救赎之重。

prophecies.title: The Day the Lord Has Made
prophecies.otText: The LORD has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.
prophecies.otTextZh: 这是耶和华所定的日子，我们在其中要高兴欢喜！
prophecies.ntText: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of it. Exalted to the right hand of God, he has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear. … Therefore let all Israel be assured of this: God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Messiah.
prophecies.ntTextZh:
这耶稣，神已经叫他复活了，我们都为这事作见证。
他既被神的右手高举（或译：他既高举在神的右边），又从父受了所应许的圣灵，就把你们所看见所听见的，浇灌下来。
大卫并没有升到天上，但自己说：主对我主说：你坐在我的右边，
等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。
「故此，以色列全家当确实地知道，你们钉在十字架上的这位耶稣，神已经立他为主，为基督了。」
prophecies.explanation: The psalmist celebrated the day the LORD had acted decisively — a day of joy and vindication. Peter at Pentecost declared that Resurrection Sunday was that day: the day God raised Jesus from the dead, exalted Him, and poured out His Spirit. What the psalm anticipated as praise, the apostles proclaimed as history.
prophecies.explanationZh: 诗篇宣告「这是耶和华所造的日子」。复活之日便是这歌唱的日子。耶稣复活的日子成为历世历代欢喜的根源。

interpretations.note: Payne's #20 covers the Psalm 118 cornerstone passage; verse 24 ('This is the day the LORD has made') is part of that same psalm cluster applied messianically

prophecies.title: The Servant Brings Justice
prophecies.otText: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out. In faithfulness he will bring forth justice;
prophecies.otTextZh: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断；将残的灯火，他不吹灭。他凭真实将公理传开。
prophecies.ntText: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out, till he has brought justice through to victory.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断；将残的灯火，他不吹灭；等他施行公理，叫公理得胜。
prophecies.explanation: Isaiah described God's Servant as one who would not crush the weak or extinguish the faint. Matthew applied these words to Jesus, whose ministry was marked by tenderness toward the broken. Where the world discards what is damaged, Jesus restores it — bringing justice not through force but through faithful compassion.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚预言神的仆人「将公理传给外邦」。耶稣让万国得知审判与怜悯。这位仆人作成从地极所应许的救恩。

interpretations.note: Payne #30 identifies Isaiah 42:1–4 as messianic; Matthew 12:18–21 quotes the full passage including verse 3 as fulfilled in Jesus's gentle ministry

prophecies.title: The King Comes Bringing Peace
prophecies.otText: I will take away the chariots from Ephraim and the warhorses from Jerusalem, and the battle bow will be broken. He will proclaim peace to the nations. His rule will extend from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.
prophecies.otTextZh: 我必除灭以法莲的战车和耶路撒冷的战马；争战的弓也必除灭。他必向列国讲和平；他的权柄必从这海管到那海，从大河管到地极。
prophecies.ntText: The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Hosanna in the highest heaven!"
prophecies.ntTextZh: 前行后随的众人喊著说：和散那（原有求救的意思，在此是称颂的话）归于大卫的子孙！奉主名来的是应当称颂的！高高在上和散那！
prophecies.explanation: Zechariah envisioned a king who would abolish weapons of war and proclaim peace to every nation. Paul declares that Christ is our peace — He has destroyed the wall of hostility between peoples. His kingdom is established not by chariots and warhorses but by the disarming power of reconciling love.
prophecies.explanationZh: 撒迦利亚预言「你的王来到……」带来和平的统治。耶稣进入耶路撒冷时满带和平印记。他所给的平安远非世界所能给。

interpretations.note: Payne #97 identifies Zechariah 9:10 as messianic, describing the universal peace and dominion of the coming King

prophecies.title: The Servant Will Be Exalted
prophecies.otText: so he will sprinkle many nations, and kings will shut their mouths because of him. For what they were not told, they will see, and what they have not heard, they will understand.
prophecies.otTextZh: 这样，他必洗净（或译：鼓动）许多国民；君王要向他闭口。因所未曾传与他们的，他们必看见；未曾听见的，他们要明白。
prophecies.ntText: Rather, as it is written: "Those who were not told about him will see, and those who have not heard will understand."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 就如经上所记：未曾闻知他信息的，将要看见；未曾听过的，将要明白。
prophecies.explanation: Isaiah declared that the Servant's mission would reach nations that had never heard of Him — even kings would be silenced. Paul quoted this passage to explain why he preached where Christ was not yet known. The gospel's reach to the ends of the earth was not an afterthought — it was written into the Servant's mission from the start.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚断言「我的仆人必行事通达」。耶稣的顺服带来高举。他的侍奉从垂死到升天，最终超乎万有。

interpretations.note: Payne #64 identifies Isaiah 52:15 as messianic; Paul quotes it in Romans 15:21 regarding the gospel going to those who had not heard

prophecies.title: Out of Egypt I Called My Son
prophecies.otText: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
prophecies.otTextZh: 以色列年幼的时候，我爱他，就从埃及召出我的儿子来。
prophecies.ntText: So was fulfilled what the Lord had said through the prophet: "Out of Egypt I called my son."
prophecies.ntTextZh: 住在那里，直到希律死了。这是要应验主藉先知所说的话，说：「我从埃及召出我的儿子来。」
prophecies.explanation: Hosea described God's love for Israel as His son, called out of Egypt in the Exodus. Matthew saw this pattern fulfilled in a deeper way when the infant Jesus returned from Egypt after Herod's death. Just as God called His people out of Egypt, He called His Son — the true Israel — along the same path, reliving and redeeming the nation's story.
prophecies.explanationZh: 何西阿说「我从埃及召出我的儿子来」。马太把耶稣从埃及归来引为此应验。以色列出埃及成为弥赛亚从埃及复兴的预表。

prophecies.title: He Will Strike the Earth with the Rod of His Mouth
prophecies.otText: but with righteousness he will judge the needy, with justice he will give decisions for the poor of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; with the breath of his lips he will slay the wicked.
prophecies.otTextZh: 却要以公义审判贫穷人，以正直判断世上的谦卑人，以口中的杖击打世界，以嘴里的气杀戮恶人。
prophecies.ntText: Coming out of his mouth is a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations. He will rule them with an iron scepter.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 有利剑从他口中出来，可以击杀列国。他必用铁杖辖管（辖管：原文是牧）他们，并要踹全能神烈怒的酒醡。
prophecies.explanation: Isaiah foresaw a Messianic ruler who would judge the earth not by military might but by the word of His mouth. In Revelation, John sees the returning Christ with a sharp sword proceeding from His mouth, striking down the nations. The Messiah's justice is absolute — His word alone is sufficient to overthrow all wickedness.
prophecies.explanationZh: 以赛亚宣告弥赛亚「用口中的杖击打世界」。这位王的言语带着审判的能力。他口中的话既立定也审判，权柄超越强权。

prophecies.title: The Lord Will Be King Over All the Earth
prophecies.otText: The LORD will be king over the whole earth. On that day there will be one LORD, and his name the only name.
prophecies.otTextZh: 耶和华必作全地的王。那日耶和华必为独一无二的，他的名也是独一无二的。
prophecies.ntText: The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will reign for ever and ever.
prophecies.ntTextZh: 第七位天使吹号，天上就有大声音说：世上的国成了我主和主基督的国；他要作王，直到永永远远。
prophecies.explanation: Zechariah proclaimed the day when the LORD alone would reign as King over all the earth, with no rival and no divided loyalty. Revelation echoes this vision: the kingdoms of this world become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ. The prophecy points to the final, uncontested reign of the Messiah over every nation.
prophecies.explanationZh: 撒迦利亚预言「耶和华必作全地的王」。弥赛亚的国度终必使普世同心敬拜一位真神。这末世性的应许正是万国盼望的终极实现。
